designStatus: Original untested source-fit protocols; no learner observations or private state changes

tasks: Use a concrete integrated portfolio of actual shape/colour/shade, hidden-form, sound, smell/taste and touch cases plus a same-event multisensory task. The broad goal is reviewed independently, not by adding child-record labels.

Actually compare varied shapes, colours and close shades using safe visible samples and simple equipment. Include changed samples, specific perceptual differences and matching/contrasting cases; a memorised colour name alone does not demonstrate discrimination.

Retain the whole existing close-observation/equipment, shape recognition across orientation/size and complete sorting/counting/ordering checks separately. No named-script or physics-colour theory requirement is imported.

Use the complete new hidden-sample recognition task across close foils and changed form families, indicating remembered features without a visible model, familiar-word cue or fixed answer position. No memory-capacity quota or clinical score.

Actually distinguish pitch, loudness and tempo using controlled/matched sound cases, varying one property while keeping the comparison interpretable. A harder pluck is not assumed to keep every other acoustic property perfectly identical.

Retain complete pitch-source-pattern/qualitative vibration, amplitude/volume and rhythm replication/repeated-sound-participation checks; supply suitable safe sound makers and equipment. Actual perceptual comparison is not replaced by instrument vocabulary or a still picture.

Complete inherited vibration/light-sound vocabulary tasks remain separate canonical checks. They are not additional universal NCERT sensory requirements. No hertz/wave-equation/advanced acoustics gate is introduced.

Use comfortable sound levels and a reliable prepared vibration setup; no forced shouting, whisper-based amplitude inference, learner confinement or forced blindfold. A failed apparatus or inaccessible material is recorded as a task limitation rather than a learner deficit.

Retain the actual sound-to-separate-matter direction with a control separating airborne sound from direct mechanical contact. A ruler resting on a speaker cone or a tuning fork touching water alone does not establish that airborne sound moved separate matter. Use a reliable suitable non-contact sound/receiver case and record the actual apparatus conditions.

Actually match and distinguish suitable familiar smell/taste sample pairs with changed coded samples, using safe declared foods/materials, hygiene and relevant allergy/access conditions. Describing organs alone is insufficient.

Retain the complete existing equipment-based close observation and comparison task separately. No blindfold, nose pinching, raw/unknown food or forced tasting is required; an inaccessible tasting case is recorded rather than silently inferred.

Actually compare safe familiar textures/materials by touch in changed cases, indicating specific differences and matching samples. Include distinctions beyond naming the skin as the sense organ. Retain complete observation/equipment requirements separately.

Use one safe episode, such as gently rubbing a familiar textured material; relate what is seen, heard and felt as aspects of the same event, including how perceptions agree/differ. Unrelated sample naming or one focus alone does not establish integration.

Use the complete new deliberate present-attention task separately, with an accessible focus, genuine noticing of attention change/thought and return, without suppressing experience or requiring private content.

Compare actual controlled note/sound pairs and judge whether pitch and volume match, then explain/indicate the comparison in changed cases. Retain complete unchanged pitch and volume canonical tasks separately.

Hear an actual change of tempo in a supplied appropriate piece and indicate it by a response such as changed beat tapping or a description. Retain complete rhythm replication and repeated sound-pattern tasks. A pitch change or louder note alone is a near miss.

The official phrase about linear/nonlinear progression within a scale is retained as meaning Unverified. No automatic tempo/mathematical-pattern substitution, new advanced topic or unsupported Full judgment.
protocols.remaining: Need a source-appropriate authoritative musical example or explanation fixing the intended distinction.

tasks: An appropriately prepared adult teaches a comfortable gentle breathing case with the out-breath actually longer than the in-breath. No retention, forced ratio, fixed rounds or therapeutic claim is added. A normal equal-duration cycle does not account for this source condition.
Assess the complete present-attention operation separately. Ordinary awareness alone does not prove the breathing performance.

Retain a short comfortable stillness opportunity with actual attention to other sensory perceptions. Still posture alone is not evidence, and the short source duty does not become a universal behavioural quota.
Complete present-attention and close-observation tasks separately, with appropriate accessible support; do not force eye closure or positive feeling.

An appropriately prepared adult demonstrates the named alternate-nostril pattern in a comfortable supported setting using ordinary unforced breathing, without any breath-holding or fixed ratio/round count.

Check the actual coordinated cycle: air enters on one side and exits the other, then enters on that second side and exits the first; appropriate gentle nostril switching is part of the taught method. Mere ordinary breath awareness or alternating hand positions without the breathing sequence does not suffice.
Keep comfortable continuous breathing and stop/reconsider an unsuitable or uncomfortable task rather than force or infer performance. Record actual support/material/access conditions.

Assess the shared present-attention claim separately. Successful awareness is a component, not proof of the named technique; likewise performing a motor sequence alone does not certify thought awareness.
protocols.resourceNotes: Named procedure/source-age duty comes from actual NCERT Grade 2 position. AYUSH 2026 printed 41–42 fixes the method; Fit India printed 45 supports no breath holding, not an alternate-nostril 5–8 table endorsement. No adult ratio/round/postural inventory or benefit claim is imported.

tasks: Use the complete present-attention task with a short comfortable ordinary quiet occasion and genuine thought-flow/attention noticing. A report may identify the process without disclosing private content; no thought, distraction or upset is manufactured.
Stillness or repeating a calming phrase is not proof. If the required event has not been observed at actual use, record insufficient evidence rather than a fabricated success or failure.
